title: A.e. strong measurability of the tangential rotation ratio for the weight of an integer multiplicity triple
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) with weight μ := R.measure = (H^n⌞M).withDensity θ (H^n = μHE[n]), Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P with orthogonal projection π = Q.starProjection, and a, e ∈ ℝ^P. Put T_x := approxTangentPlane n M x with orthogonal projection p_{T_x}, Ax := ⟨x,a⟩e − ⟨x,e⟩a and G(x) := |p_{T_x}(Ax)|² / |πx|² (real division, t/0 = 0). Then G : ℝ^P → ℝ is μ-a.e. strongly measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P), AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : Euclid P => ‖(approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2) R.measure
